Messages.Author: BobbyDoc
Messages.Body:
Hi,

sorry for this. But I want to clarify everything with this card in one
mail.

Matthias is bleeding and get blocked by Brunhilde.
In the combat Matthias hits Brunhilde with AT at superiour at close
range.
Are any of these assumptions incorrect?
a. Brunhilde can play cards to prevent the damage from AT.
b. If Brunhilde play S:CE she will not take any damage from AT.
c. If Brunhilde play dodge she will not take any damage from AT.
d. Matthias do not take any damage from Brunhildes hand strike.
e. Matthias do not take any damage from Brunhildes hand strike played
as First Strike.
f. Matthias do not take any damage from the Carrion Crows Brunhilde
played.

Robert

Anesthetic Touch
Only usable at close range.
[aus] Strike: dodge.
[obe] Strike: make a hand strike. Combat ends immediately after the
resolution of this strike.
[OBE] As [obe] above, with First Strike.

Yes. Crows' damage, like damage-dealing retainers' damage, is done during the
normal strike resolution time.
